result_text:
I changed the two mock-folder rules in `addTestConventions` (`ScopingConventions.java`, lines 393–394). `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest='Scoping*'` passes, but I didn't add a test or run any paths through the new patterns. My ad-hoc check of the example paths was blocked, so the behaviour below is from reading the code.

The old patterns were `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*`. They are now `.*/__mock[^/\\]*/.*` and `.*/mock[^/\\]*/.*`. The `+` became `*`, so a folder named plainly `mock` matches. The ASCII character class became "anything except a path separator", so punctuation and non-ASCII names such as `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe` and `mock模拟` match.

- **Single folder name:** the match still needs a `/` right before `mock`, so `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, `mock.java` and `mockery.java` stay out. The earlier folders (`mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/`, `mockStore/`) still match.
- **Backslash paths:** `SourceFile` filtering already tries each pattern against a `\`-to-`/` version of the path, so Windows-style paths work with no extra code.
- **Top-level folder:** a `mock/` folder at the very start of a relative path, with nothing before it, still isn't matched. That was already true of the old rule, and I left it alone.
